ctx.x: What -- do you remember what year that was?

Well, it'd have to be when I was with Lunceford, so that would be between '37 and -- it would be between '37 and '40 or '41. It had to be between there because that's -- those are the years I worked with Lunceford. And he was a good friend of Willie and (unintelligible) Fishelli, you know, because Norman didn't have a car then and Fishelli used to let him use their car. Sometime you talk to Fishelli about Norman. You'd learn.
